issues.description: The template implementation for GroverMultiQubitWithAuxiliaryQubit.simulate declares a return type of list[complex] but the problem statement and the reference solution expect simulation counts (a histogram / dict[str,int]). This mismatch in the template's type annotation/signature can confuse students about the expected return value and lead to type-related mistakes when implementing the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature and docstring for simulate in ex2_grover_multi_qubit_with_auxiliary_qubit.py to return a counts mapping (e.g. -> dict[str, int]) and update the docstring to state that it should run the circuit and return measurement counts. Align this with the problem statement (which expects simulation counts) and the reference solution.
